title: RC-26 getBundleStatsV2: per-builder telemetry is queried on every Flashbots attempt inside the wallet nonce lock, and the operator remediation text relies on it; whether the endpoint still answers was not re-verified (no network allowed)

evidence.note: after every bundle.wait(), on success and failure, await flashbotsProvider.getBundleStatsV2(bundleHash, targetBlock); any error is caught and only logged (flashbots.bundle.stats.error)
this runs inside the submit closure, which runs inside withNonceLock (bot.ts:267, exitEngine.ts:788, :1531)
the snipe fail-clean remediation tells the operator to "inspect per-builder coverage in the op:flashbots.bundle.stats logs"
getBundleStatsV2 is one relay request; request() (:793-806) throws "Request failed with status <code>" on a non-2xx answer, which the strategy catch turns into a warn log
the request uses the FetchRequest default 300000 ms (idle) timeout, so a hanging relay extends the lock hold of every attempt by up to 5 minutes

sibling_sites_checked: The only stats call is flashbots.ts:345; the deprecated getBundleStats (library :523) is not used. bot.ts:382 is the only operator text that relies on the stats logs. The research claim that the endpoint answers 403 since 2025-06-09 is a web claim; this plan makes no network calls, so it stays unverified here.
severity_rationale: S3, equal to the research suggestion: misleading telemetry and operator guidance, plus a small, bounded addition to the nonce-lock hold time of every ETH attempt (one relay round trip; up to the 300 s idle timeout if the relay hangs), which feeds the RC-11 hold time (AUD-TX-003). Status candidate because the 403 behaviour is not re-measured offline.
recommendation: Phase 29 (card TX-03): verify the endpoint in Phase 23; if it is dead, remove the call and the operator text that relies on it and reconcile by receipts only (research recommendation); if kept, move it out of the nonce lock and give it a short timeout.
